summary: Iteration 5: I tested the backend and the frontend. Unit tests (npm test) pass 15/15. New pytest suite: 23 of 26 pass. The failures are 1 HIGH payments bug, 1 seed-data gap and 1 legacy data row. The verification gate works end to end: unverified users get 403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED; Stripe Identity returns 503 with a friendly message and the webhook returns 503 'not configured' (status shows not_started); right-to-work validation works and the status moves to pending; registering returns 503 'verification email could not be sent' and login is then refused with EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED; the admin queue shows the share code and the GOV.UK link; admin approval unlocks the account. The core payments and fees maths is correct. Workchat redesign works on desktop: plum header, blush own bubbles, distinct reactions, reply, send and GIF all work. Issues found: (1) the mobile header hides the group name; (2) direct chats still have a white header, not plum; (3) Pin permission differs between UI and API; (4) the invoice ignores the employer's counter-offer. I also found and fixed a seeder crash. The seeder was re-run at the end and the demo data is restored.

payments_fees_pass_fail_table.rule: Fee £2/h when rate <= £20 (all demo checkouts, e.g. £13.50 x 4h = £8.00)

payments_fees_pass_fail_table.result: PASS in unit tests; legacy test checkout #1 (test.worker, £22.50 x 9.5h) stores a £20.25 fee where it should be £21.38. This is old seed data, not the current code

payments_fees_pass_fail_table.rule: Employer total / invoice total = gross + fee (all invoices)
Checkout approval creates an 'issued' invoice due today+14 (Late Bar checkout: £54 + £8 = £62, due 2026-11-19)
Counter-offer validation (comment >= 3 chars) and counterGrossPay (19:00-22:00 = £40.50, status disputed)
Invoice after a counter-offer bills the counter amount
payments_fees_pass_fail_table.result: FAIL: invoice bills the worker's original £54.00 + £8.00 fee, while the payslip pays the counter £40.50

payments_fees_pass_fail_table.rule: Employer cancels shift <24h: 409 with fee preview (Cocktail Bar Host 13.75 x 4.75h x 50% = £32.66 per worker)
Employer removes approved worker <24h: 409 first, then confirmCancellationFee charges £32.66 (saved on the application)
Worker cancels approved shift <24h: 409, then confirmStrike records a strike
No-show rejected before shift end (409); allowed after end, records a strike
Payment preferences validation (£1-£1,000,000; cadence instant/3_days/7_days/14_days); saved values persist
Admin invoices: list, status change, paid->void blocked (400), reminder 503 graceful, reminder on paid 400
Pay settings validation (bad code / Scottish S code / bad NI category / not confirmed all return 400)
PAYE payslip maths (1257L weekly non-cumulative, NI 8% over £242/week): tax/NI/net recomputed independently
Contractor payslips: net = gross, no deductions

critical.issue: The invoice uses c.gross_pay and c.platform_fee and ignores counter_gross_pay. The employer is billed £54 + £8 for a shift the payslip pays as £40.50 (payroll-routes uses COALESCE(counter_gross_pay, gross_pay)). The fee is also not recalculated for the counter hours. Fix: in index.js ~line 1278, use COALESCE(counter_gross_pay, gross_pay) for the subtotal and recalculate the fee with calculatePay on the counter times. Decide whether approving a disputed checkout accepts the counter.

minor.issue: The API only lets workchat admins pin (canManageWorkchat), but the UI shows 'Pin message' to every sender on their own messages. A worker clicking it gets a silent 403 'Only workchat admins can pin messages.' The reverse also happens: the employer (workchat owner) is not offered 'Pin' on other people's messages, because the UI checks workchatParticipants is_admin and not ownership. Align the UI condition with canManageWorkchat.
There is no check on the current status. A checkout that is open, rejected or already approved can be re-reviewed. Rejecting after approval leaves the issued invoice in place.

within24Hours requires timeUntilStart >= 0. A worker who cancels an approved shift that has already started (or ended) gets no strike. Employer DELETE /api/shifts/:id treats past shifts as within 24h and charges the fee.

new.employer@hyrz.local is seeded with company_check_reason NULL, so admin-company-check-<id> never renders for the seeded account (it only appears for real sign-ups, where runCompanyCheck sets 'Automatic Companies House checks are not set up yet...'). Set a reason in the seeder.

ui_bugs.issue: The group name H3 and the '5 members' line have width 0, so they are invisible. The search and settings icons sit at x=383-452 on a 390px screen, which is off-screen. Only the back button and avatar show. Make the title copy flex:1 with min-width:0 and keep the header icons inside the viewport (e.g. reduce the header gap or let the icons shrink).

The header is still white (#fff) with a #111 title. The plum theme is not applied. RCA: chat.css .hz-room{--hz-head:#FFFFFF} wins on load order, and chat.css:174/176 force the title and subtitle colours with 'html body #root .app .hz-room.hz-room ... !important'. Fix: in workchat-theme.css, use the same high-specificity selector with !important for --hz-head, the .hz-title strong/small colours and the icons.
The circles are filled rgb(41,41,41) on the plum header, so the icon is almost invisible.
On the worker page, the Verified / Not started / Pending pills render as dark pills with dark text and are unreadable. The employer page shows the same badges correctly (light background).

integration_issues.issue: The Pin button is shown, the API returns 403 and no error is visible to the user.

For reply bubbles, the text line has a narrower blush background than the quote above it, so the bubble looks split.

The active tab uses black text on crimson.
There are two sign-out icons in the Inbox header.
The date of birth field uses the browser's native date picker, not the app's calendar component.
The 'Dashboard sections' cards (Checkouts / Invoices / Finances) are about 420px tall and empty except for a label. They look like missing images.

critical_code_review_comments: index.js is 1469 lines and App.jsx 1646 lines with very long single-line JSX; split them into modules
The worker_strikes and shift_confirmation_invites CREATE TABLE statements are repeated inside request handlers; move them to startup migrations

updated_files: /app/server/scripts/seed-demo-data.js (wipe() now deletes disputes and worker_strikes for the demo business/workers. Before this, the seeder crashed with an FK error on disputes_ibfk_1 after any counter-offer, and strikes piled up across runs)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. A TEST_ user registered during testing was deleted by id. The seeder was re-run at the end, and employer payment preferences were restored to their defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the pytest suite serially: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_hyrz_iter5_verification_payments.py -n 0. It changes demo data, so re-run the seeder afterwards. Token login in Playwright: POST /api/auth/login, then localStorage 'hyrz_token'. Workchat actions appear when you click .workchat-message-bubble; reaction buttons have aria-label 'React <emoji>' (👍❤️😂😮😢👏🎉🙏). Employer = Sam Demo; worker = Alex Demo.
rca of the issue: Direct chat white header: chat.css .hz-room sets --hz-head:#FFFFFF, and its 'html body #root .app .hz-room.hz-room' !important colour rules beat the theme's plain '.hz-room .hz-head' rules. Mobile workchat header: the title copy shrinks to 0 width because the fixed-size header icons overflow the 390px row. Seeder crash: wipe() deleted checkouts without first deleting the disputes rows that counter-offers create (FK).
